# VibeCode Mentor: The Ultimate Vibecoding & AI Blueprint Platform

> **VibeCode Mentor** is an AI-powered co-founder and software technical architect designed to transform vague ideas into production-ready blueprints in minutes. It is the ultimate platform for **Vibecoding**, enabling developers and founders to ship full-stack applications with extreme speed using AI guidance.

## 🚀 Core Features & Capabilities

- **AI-Powered Blueprints:** Generates 14+ section project blueprints including database schemas (SQL), API specifications, tech stack dependency lists, and complete file structures.
- **Architectural Reasoning:** Built-in expert logic explaining *why* specific technologies (Next.js, Supabase, Tailwind) are chosen for your specific use case.
- **Step-by-Step Implementation Guides:** Detailed 7-phase build plans with exact terminal commands, code snippets, and verification checkpoints.
- **LLM-Context-Rich Prompts:** Provides 5 copy-paste-ready prompts for AI coding assistants (like Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT) to implement core project features instantly.
- **Developer-Focused Templates:** 19+ specialized templates for APIs, CLIs, Chrome Extensions, and SaaS boilerplate.
- **AI Chat Assistant:** Context-aware assistant to help you refine blueprints and answer technical questions (Powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro).
- **Vibecoding Optimization:** Specifically designed for the "Vibecoding" workflow where ideas are drafted and iterated upon using high-level natural language.

## 🛠️ Technology Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS (Modern, Minimalistic B&W Theme)
- **Database & Auth:** Supabase (PostgreSQL) + NextAuth.js
- **AI Models:** 
  - **Pro:** Google Gemini 1.5 Pro (High-precision reasoning)
  - **Free:** Mistral AI (Fast, efficient generation)
- **Monitoring & Scale:** Vercel Analytics, KV, and Speed Insights
- **Payments:** Lemon Squeezy (SaaS Subscription Management)

## 🎯 Target Audience

- **Developers:** Building tools, APIs, and complex extensions.
- **Solo Founders:** Rapidly prototyping and launching SaaS products.
- **Creators:** Turning creative ideas into working web applications.
- **Builders:** Shipping consistent, high-quality code with AI assistance.

## 🌍 SEO Meta Info

- **Keywords:** Vibecoding, Vibe Coding, AI Project Blueprint, Software Architect AI, Code Generator, SaaS Boilerplate, Next.js Starter, Supabase Auth.
- **Mission:** Empowering anyone to transition "From Vibe to Live" with production-grade software planning.

## 📦 Export & Integration

- **Github Integration:** Create repositories directly from blueprints (Pro).
- **Formats:** Export blueprints as Markdown or PDF documentation.
- **PWA:** Fully installable as a mobile or desktop application.
